title: Alex Gutierrez
text: My name is Alejandro but I often prefer to go by Alex. I’m an international student from Costa Rica. I have a bachelor’s in computer software engineering and worked as an AEM Front End developer for 6 years. I’d like to become a data engineer or data scientist which is why I started MDS.

title: My first weeks in MDS
text:
Ax park we found while exploring campus.


Orientation was a lot of fun, although it was also a little overwhelming with the amount of information we received. It gave me a much better understanding of what to expect from the program, especially in terms of the fast course pacing and the importance of always staying up to date with everything.
I’ve also made a few great friends so far, and they’re incredibly smart. They’ve already helped me better understand some of the more challenging tasks we’ve encountered in our labs, which has made adjusting to the program a lot easier.

title: About
text: I worked for about 6 years as an AEM (Adobe Experience Manager) web developer for major car brands in the US and Canadian market. My work included projects related to major site redesigns and improvements. In addition to that, I also worked on implementing and optimizing frontend analytics and accessibility solutions, authored technical and instructional documentation for complex components, and developed reusable component features for streamlined site updates.
